subject: PO format, net terms authorization & early-invoice lane
messages:
From: Ava Roberts <procurement@healthedge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HealthEdge PO template / net terms question

Hi Dylan & Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — moving this to procurement now. Attached is our standard PO template (HealthEdge_PO_Template_20270725.pdf). A couple of asks from our side so we can onboard Redwood in our ERP:  

- Can Redwood accept our PO format as-is, or do you require certain fields (ERP SKU, bill-to entity, expense GL)?
- Our standard payment term is Net 45; would Redwood accept Net 45 on the first 12 months of the contract?
- We typically prefer monthly invoices (monthly statement). Is that compatible with your billing cadence and any discount programs you offer for aggregated billing?

If you can confirm the PO field mapping and whether an early-invoice (one-time prebill for ramp month) is possible, procurement can issue the signed PO next week.

Thanks,
Ava Roberts
Senior Procurement Manager, HealthEdge
procurement@healthedge.com
(415) 555-1212

Attachment: HealthEdge_PO_Template_20270725.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ava Roberts <procurement@healthedge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthEdge PO template / net terms question

Hi Ava — appreciate the clear PO template. Short answers up front: we can accept your PO with a couple of required fields populated, Net 45 is acceptable for the first 12 months, and we can support monthly invoices plus a one-time prebill for ramp. Details below.

Required PO fields (please include these on the PO):
- PO identifier in the format: PO-HE-2027-<numeric seq> (helps our billing/ERP match)
- Bill-to entity (legal name) and remit address
- Line items must include our catalog SKU or service description; if you prefer, we can map your internal SKU to Redwood SKUs in a short mapping table (we'll provide).
- Tax entity (if applicable) and currency (USD).

Billing terms and options:
- Net 45 standard: yes, Redwood Finance can accept Net 45 for the first 12 months.
- Invoice cadence: We can issue monthly invoices aligned to your preferred bill-run date.
- Early/prebill: We can push a one-time prebill for the ramp month but will need that noted on the PO as a separate line item ("pre-activation credit / one-time invoice").

Discounts / packaging notes:
- We do have a modest credit available if a customer agrees to quarterly consolidated invoicing versus monthly (we can offer a 1.5% credit on billed usage if quarterly invoicing agreed).
- If HealthEdge is willing to commit to a minimum annualized spend band (we can share tiers from the attached redwood_rate_card_v3.xlsx), additional discounts are possible.

Next steps:
- If you can send the signed PO with the PO-HE-2027-<seq> format, I will coordinate with Finance to set up the billing lane and confirm ERP mappings.
- Vanessa, can you confirm the SKU mapping template and whether we need an initial AP vendor setup form?

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Dylan_Brooks@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_rate_card_v3.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthEdge PO template / net terms question

Adding Finance notes:  

- We can accept the PO format described by Ava as long as the PO includes the mandatory fields Dylan called out. Please ensure PO numbers follow PO-HE-2027-#### to avoid manual reconciliation.
- Net 45: approved for first 12 months, subject to standard Redwood credit checks.
- Early-pay / discount: Finance is prepared to offer a 2% early-pay discount if payment is received within 15 days (EOM or per-invoice) — however, this must be documented as an "early payment discount" on the invoice and in the PO terms.
- Consolidated invoicing credit: confirm whether Ava prefers monthly billing; if they switch to quarterly consolidated statements we can apply the 1.5% credit Dylan noted, but this requires a signed amendment to the SOW (we'll draft).

Action items for internal ops:  
- Vanessa: prepare SKU mapping template and vendor on-boarding checklist; I'll prep credit approval form.

-Marissa
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

(Internal note) Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

From: Ava Roberts <procurement@healthedge.com>

Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@healthedge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-28T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthEdge PO template / net terms question

Thanks — that all looks workable. Confirming the following so procurement can issue the signed PO tomorrow:  

- We'll issue PO: PO-HE-2027-0842 (signed PO attached: HealthEdge_PO_signed_20270726.pdf).
- Net 45 accepted for months 1–12. We'll include language on the PO referencing the 2% early-pay discount if Redwood documents the discount on the invoice.
- We prefer monthly invoices. For the ramp month we will accept one prebill as a separate line item (please include prebill amount on the invoice).
- We would like Redwood to provide the SKU mapping spreadsheet so our AP team can map line items when the PO is loaded into our ERP.

Please confirm receipt and that Finance will set up the vendor with the PO number so we can close this out. Also, we'd appreciate a short amendment (one-paragraph) describing the consolidated-invoicing credit option should we elect to move to quarterly billing later.

Best,
Ava Roberts
Senior Procurement Manager, HealthEdge

Attachment: HealthEdge_PO_signed_20270726.pdf
